name: How much does a full backyard renovation cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a full backyard renovation cost in Los Angeles for a typical home?
mainEntity.text: How much does a full backyard renovation cost in Los Angeles for a typical home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backyard renovation pricing in Los Angeles varies widely because labor, permitting, access, site conditions, and finish level all affect the final number. Simple patio and landscaping refreshes may fall in the $20,000 to $50,000 range. A more complete outdoor living project with upgraded hardscape, lighting, fire features, shade structures, or irrigation often lands between $50,000 and $120,000. Once you add a new pool, spa, outdoor kitchen, premium stone, or custom structures, total budgets commonly move into the $120,000 to $250,000+ range. The best way to budget is to separate must-haves from nice-to-haves, then price the project in phases. That helps homeowners prioritize the features that deliver the most value without overbuilding for the neighborhood or property size.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full backyard renovation in Los Angeles often ranges from about $50,000 to $250,000+, depending on size, materials, and features. Smaller patio-and-landscape updates can start around $20,000 to $50,000, while pool-inclusive or highly customized outdoor living projects can cost much more.
